source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 9.1, PDF page 210 (printed p. 203)
about: Table 9.1, "The parameters that characterize the two layers M1 and M2. The layer M1 is in contact with the facing and the layer M2 with the rigid impervious backing": the two-layer material behind the perforated facing of Figures 9.17 and 9.18 (facing 1 mm thick, holes of radius 0.5 mm, perforation ratio 0.005). Columns as printed: flow resistivity sigma (N m-4 s), viscous dimension Lambda (mm), thermal dimension Lambda' (mm), tortuosity, porosity and thickness e (cm). This is the one table of the book that prints the lengths in millimetres and the thickness in centimetres; both are converted here to the micrometres and millimetres of the rest of the catalogue.
